description: Kernel-attribute initialization is cached by kernel pointer without device identity.
trigger: Select the same GEMM kernel on another CUDA device after it has been cached on the first device.
expected_behavior: Configure the required dynamic shared-memory limit for each device on which the kernel is launched.
actual_behavior: Both exl3_gemm and exl3_mgemm skip cudaFuncSetAttribute when a kernel pointer is already in the process-global set, regardless of current device.

introductions.rationale: 188 introduces the shared kernel-pointer set in both launchers.

verification.description: Reviewer traced current-device lookup, pointer-only cache and dynamic shared-memory launch requests. The verdict cites later upstream repair as hindsight corroboration; no fix is recorded at this walk position.
verification.limits: Suspected, source only; CUDA documentation establishing per-device attribute semantics was not inspected, and no CUDA or multi-device execution was performed.

affected_revisions.limits: Reviewer source-supported revision only; no executed failure or continuous affected range established.

cutoff_note: Reviewer-only observation; never teacher input. Reviewer-originated label retained despite the ledger validator origin limitation.
